issue.title: example: add statustext_hello to show all StatusTextType severity levels

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
Closes #2871

## Summary

Adds `examples/statustext_hello` — a minimal companion-computer example that calls `ServerUtility::send_status_text()` once for each of the eight MAVLink severity levels (Debug through Emergency).

- Sends Debug, Info, Notice, Warning, Error, Critical, Alert, Emergency in sequence with a 500 ms gap between each
- Runs as `ComponentType::CompanionComputer` so messages appear as a separate MAVLink source in QGC
- No custom chunking needed — MAVSDK handles messages longer than 50 bytes internally

## Test plan

- [ ] Build: `cmake -Bbuild cpp/examples/statustext_hello && cmake --build build`
- [ ] Run against SITL: `./statustext_hello udpin://0.0.0.0:14540`
- [ ] Confirm all eight severity levels appear in QGC HUD / Messages pane
